landing.title: SplashTrack
landing.foundationNotice: The foundation is in place. There is no functionality yet — the first module follows.
landing.enrolNotice: You have not set up an authenticator yet. Until you do, this account can do nothing else.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.title: This installation is not set up yet
setup.noAdministrator: There is no administrator yet. Set this installation up with the wizard at /setup. It asks for a one-time token, which you issue from the host — host access is the proof of ownership here:
setup.pendingTitle: Almost there: the administrator still has to set up an authenticator
setup.pendingExplanation: The administrator account exists but has no second factor yet. Until it does, this installation is not set up, and that account can do nothing but sign in and set up its authenticator.
setup.pendingAction: Sign in with the password you chose when the account was created. You are taken to the enrolment page automatically.
setup.pendingSignIn: Sign in and set up your authenticator
setup.noRegistration: There is no self-registration: accounts are created by an administrator.

setupWizard.title: Set up SplashTrack
setupWizard.subtitle: This installation has not been set up yet. Three steps, and then this page closes itself for good.

token.heading: Step 1 — the one-time setup token
token.explanation: Whoever can reach the host owns this installation. The token is in a file on the container's data volume. Read it:
token.whyNotInTheLog: The token is deliberately NOT in the container log. Logs get pasted into public issues, and whoever holds this token becomes the administrator of this installation. So do not paste it anywhere either.
token.label: Setup token
token.help: 32 characters. Dashes, spaces and letter case do not matter.

errors.MISMATCH: That token is not right. Check that you copied the whole value.
errors.EXPIRED: That token has expired. Issue a new one on the host: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.ALREADY_USED: That token has already been used. A token works exactly once. Issue a new one: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.NO_TOKEN_ISSUED: No token has been issued. Create one on the host: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.LOCKED_OUT: Too many failed attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
errors.CLOSED: This installation is no longer asking for a token. Reload the page.

administrator.heading: Step 2 — the organisation and the first administrator
administrator.explanation: This runs the database migrations and creates the first administrator. That account gets full control of this installation.
administrator.organizationNameHelp: The name of your swim school or club. It appears throughout the application and you can change it later.
administrator.name: Administrator's name
administrator.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. Choose something you can remember or that lives in your password manager — there is no email password reset.
administrator.thenMfa: The last step follows immediately: a QR code for your authenticator. This installation is not set up until that second factor is verified.

errors.organisation: Enter an organisation name of at most 120 characters.
errors.email: That is not a valid email address.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists for that email address.
errors.password: The password must be between 12 and 128 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.closed: This step is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.failed: Setting up failed. The reason is in the container log: docker compose logs app

enrolment.intro: Step 3 — the last one. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the six digits. Only then is this installation set up, and /setup closes itself.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.codePrompt: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
signIn.badCredentials: Sign-in failed. Check your email address and password.
signIn.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass access was used
breakGlass.explanation: Somebody with host access ran a break-glass command. Check that it was expected before dismissing this.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: People, memberships and pupils. Three separate things — a child can take lessons without being a member, and a member need never swim.

denied.title: No access
denied.explanation: You are not permitted to do this. Required: {permission}. Ask an administrator to extend your role.

errors.denied: You are not permitted to do this.
errors.validation: The submitted details are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.ALREADY_OPEN: This member already has an open membership period. End that one first, so the gap between two periods stays visible.
errors.NOT_OPEN: There is no open membership period to end. Returning starts a new period; a closed period is never reopened.
errors.ENDS_BEFORE_IT_STARTS: A membership period cannot end before it started.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Name, member number or pupil number

fields.dateOfBirthHelp: Leave blank if you do not know it. Never enter a guess: with an unknown date of birth guardian authority lapses automatically and the consent appears in the queue.

membership.numberHelp: Leave blank to allocate one automatically. The member number stays the same, including across a break.
membership.returnHelp: Returning starts a new period. The old period stays, so 'when was this person a member?' remains answerable.

student.numberHelp: Leave blank to allocate one automatically. Separate from the member number: that is a different register.
student.reasonPurpose: A short note about this event. No medical or sensitive information — the medical and pastoral notes exist for that.

relationships.subject: Concerns
relationships.evidencePurpose: Record HOW the relationship was established — for example 'mother, given at registration on 2024-09-01' or 'court order seen on 2025-03-14'. Required if this person may give consent. This field is stored encrypted and every time somebody opens it that is recorded.
relationships.relativeIdHelp: Copy the id from the address bar on that person's page.
relationships.noGuardians: Nobody is recorded as answering for this person.
relationships.noDependants: This person is not recorded as answering for anybody.

evidence.title: Evidence for the relationship
evidence.auditNotice: The fact that you opened this has been recorded in the audit trail, with your name and the moment.
evidence.none: No evidence was recorded for this relationship.
evidence.claimNotice: This is what the school was told and how it was established. It is evidence of a claim, not a legal determination of guardianship.

mfaEnrolment.title: Set up your authenticator
mfaEnrolment.intro: You are signed in as {email}. This account cannot do anything until a second factor is set up.
mfaEnrolment.whyPassword: Enter your password once more. That stops anyone holding a hijacked session from quietly adding an authenticator of their own.
mfaEnrolment.unavailable: The QR code could not be produced. Please try again.
mfaEnrolment.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
mfaEnrolment.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfaEnrolment.manualKeyLabel: Cannot scan? Type this key instead:
mfaEnrolment.manualKeyHelp: Choose "enter a setup key" or "manual entry" in your app. Case and spaces do not matter.
mfaEnrolment.backupCodesHelp: Keep these somewhere safe and off this device. Each works once, and they are your only way back if you lose your authenticator.
mfaEnrolment.codeHelp: The six digits your app is showing now.
mfaEnrolment.reloadWarning: Do not reload this page: the QR code disappears and you start again from your password.
